description: A React component for a message input textbox with suggestion providers, markdown rendering, and event handling, used in Mattermost chat application.

classes.name: Textbox
classes.description: A React component for a chat input textbox with suggestion support, markdown preview, and event handling.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events on the textbox input.

methods.name: updateSuggestions
methods.description: Updates suggestion providers when relevant props change.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches agents when component mounts to populate suggestions.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles focus and updates suggestions after component updates.

methods.name: checkMessageLength
methods.description: Checks if message exceeds character limit and triggers error handling.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, casting to specific event type.

methods.name: getInputBox
methods.description: Returns the current textbox input element.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the textbox input.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns style object based on preview state.
